name: What a braneworld is: bulk field equations + brane action + junction conditions + Z2 identification (Randall-Sundrum-type construction)

source.located: Randall & Sundrum, 'An Alternative to Compactification', hep-th/9906064 (1999), eqs 3-5 and p.5; Shiromizu, Maeda & Sasaki, 'The Einstein Equations on the 3-Brane World', gr-qc/9910076 (2000), eqs 6, 12-16; Israel, Nuovo Cim. 44B, 1 (1966) = SMS ref [19], NAMED-NOT-READ, read via SMS eq 15 and Konya gr-qc/0605119 eq 19 (alpha=0).
source.via: alphaXiv answer_pdf_queries page text for hep-th/9906064v1, gr-qc/9910076v3, gr-qc/0605119v4, 1211.5448v1. Israel 1966 itself: READ-VIA-RESTATEMENT (SMS eq 15; Konya eq 19).

published_statement: RS2 (hep-th/9906064 p.2, eq 3): 'The action for our system is S = S_gravity + S_brane + S_brane', S_gravity = int d4x dy sqrt(-G){-Lambda + 2M^3 R}, S_brane = int d4x sqrt(-g_brane){V_brane + L_brane}'; 'The coupling to the branes ... and the related orbifold boundary conditions are described in Refs [8]'; eq 4 ds^2 = e^{-2k|y|} eta dx dx + dy^2; eq 5 'The solution holds only when ... V_brane = -V_brane' = 24 M^3 k, Lambda = -24 M^3 k^2'. RS2 p.5: 'we were initially interested in studying a theory without the orbifold boundary condition ... It is trivial to extend the set-up ... to a fully infinite extra dimension by allowing even and odd functions of z ... From now on we will consider this to be the case.' SMS (gr-qc/9910076): 'In the beginning we do not assume any conditions on the bulk spacetime. Later, we assume the Z2-symmetry and confinement of the matter energy momentum tensor on the brane, in accordance with the brane world scenario based on the Horava & Witten theory'; eq 13 T = -Lambda g + S delta(chi), S = -lambda q + tau, 'S should be evaluated by the variational principle of the 4-dimensional Lagrangian for matter fields'; eq 15 'The singular behaviour in the energy-momentum tensor leads us to the so-called Israel's junction condition [q]=0, [K_mu nu] = -kappa5^2 (S_mu nu - q_mu nu S/3)'; eq 16 'Now we impose the Z2-symmetry ... K+ = -K- = -(1/2) kappa5^2 (S - qS/3)'.
published_hypotheses: 5D bulk obeying Einstein's equations with (negative) bulk cosmological constant (RS2 eq 3; SMS eq 6, 13)
brane is a thin (distributional, delta-function) hypersurface with stress tensor S_mu nu from a brane Lagrangian (tension + matter) (RS2 eq 3; SMS eq 13-14)
Gaussian normal coordinate chi with a_mu = 0 near the brane (SMS eq 11-12)
Israel junction condition is DERIVED from the singular part of the Einstein equations with the delta source (SMS eq 15, citing Israel 1966)

Z2 symmetry about the brane is an ADDITIONAL, imposed assumption, motivated by Horava-Witten (SMS p.2-3 'we assume', 'we impose'); RS2 uses orbifold boundary conditions to regulate the KK sum and then drops them for the infinite extra dimension (RS2 p.5)
fine tuning V_brane = 24 M^3 k, Lambda = -24 M^3 k^2 (zero 4D cosmological constant), 'accepted without further explanation' (RS2 eq 5)
hypothesis_drift: ADDED (latticectc.py:79-80, :140-143 CODIM1_CTC_REFUSAL): Z2 identification listed as a required ingredient of 'a braneworld'. At source it is an imposed extra assumption (SMS 'Now we impose the Z2-symmetry'), RS2 itself drops the orbifold boundary condition for the infinite fifth dimension (p.5), and non-Z2 braneworlds are an established literature (Konya gr-qc/0605119 and its refs [10]: Battye-Carter, Carter-Uzan, Stoica-Tye-Wasserman, Padilla, Gergely...). Machine-checked here (C4, C4b): an asymmetric warp k1 != k2 solves the bulk equations on both sides and the full junction conditions with no Z2.

ADDED-AS-INDEPENDENT (latticectc.py:78-80): the four 'missing ingredients' are listed as four; at source the Israel junction condition is the distributional content of the bulk field equation with a brane source (SMS eq 15 'the singular behaviour ... leads us to'); machine-checked (C3): the delta-coefficient of G_mu nu equals the Israel condition exactly. Three are one requirement (field equations with a specified brane source) plus one optional symmetry.

ADDED (latticectc.py:78-81): thin-brane (junction-condition) form required. Smooth thick-brane braneworlds sourced by a bulk scalar have no junction condition and no brane action; machine-checked here (C5: A = b ln cosh(cy), kappa^2 phi'^2 = 3A'' >= 0, field equations hold). The DeWolfe-Freedman-Gubser-Karch construction (hep-th/9909134) is NAMED-NOT-READ; the check stands on its own computation. Discovered later literature (1910.09530, 2004.11398, 2011.11093) is the thick-brane line, titles/abstracts only.

CONSISTENT, not drift (latticectc.py:79-80): the quoted Israel form [K_ab] - h_ab[K] = -8 pi G5 S_ab matches Konya eq 19 (alpha=0) verbatim and SMS eq 15 after trace inversion in d=4 (C3, general symbolic identity), with K_ab = h nabla n, n pointing from - to +, [X] = X+ - X-.

CONSISTENT (latticectc.py:148-151 O3_ANSWERED_BY): the operative criterion for O3 asks only 'bulk satisfies its field equations with Israel junction conditions' -- no Z2, no separate brane action -- which is the source-level content; the stronger four-item list appears only in the refusal text (:78-81, :141-144).

INTERNAL ASYMMETRY (latticectc.py:20-23 H3 vs :78-81): the tree's own seated lattice theorem takes branes as TEST hypersurfaces 'carrying no back-reaction' -- i.e. no brane action entering a junction condition -- while the refusal disqualifies the refused construction partly for lacking those same ingredients. The flat bulk does satisfy the vacuum field equation; H3 is named, so this is a recorded scope difference, not an error. The lattice theorem is correctly styled a flat-quotient theorem, not a braneworld (junction) result.
STATUS: the tree cites no source for the definition ('none (no source cited)'): it was DECLARED; it is now READ at RS2 and SMS.

rederivation.outcome: 26/26 PASS, exit 0. C1: for ds^2 = e^{-2A(y)} eta + dy^2, G^mu_nu = (6A'^2 - 3A'') delta, G^y_y = 6A'^2 (full Christoffel/Ricci computation). C2: A = k|y| reproduces RS2 eq 5 exactly (V = 24M^3 k, Lambda_RS = -24M^3 k^2 under 1/(2 kappa^2) = 2M^3), SMS k = kappa^2 lambda/6, SMS eq 18 Lambda_4 = 0. C3: the delta part of G_mu nu IS the Israel condition; the tree's form and SMS eq 15 are the same statement (general symbolic identity, d=4); Z2 gives K+ = -K- = -k q. C4/C4b: k1 != k2 asymmetric solution satisfies bulk equations on both sides, the jump condition (tension 3(k1+k2)/kappa^2) and the normal-normal constraint S^ab{K_ab} = [T_nn] -- Z2 not required. C5: smooth thick brane solves the field equations with a real scalar, no junction, no brane action. C6: NEC for this warp class <=> A'' >= 0; RS positive-tension brane satisfies it, a negative-tension brane violates it at the brane.

later_literature.what: Braneworld 'without Z2-symmetry': single brane between two bulks, generalized Israel condition [K]-h[K]+... = -kappa^2 S (eq 19, reduces to the tree's form at alpha=0); 'Most brane-world scenarios assume a Z2-symmetry ... motivated by ... Horava and Witten. However, many recent papers examine models not directly derived from M-theory' -- Z2 is an assumption, not a defining ingredient. (Also finds Z2-breaking terms decay at late times: cosmologically they revert to Z2 form -- evidence the RS-type Z2 form is the generic late-time endpoint, not that asymmetric ones are not braneworlds.)

Uses the SMS effective equations, i.e. the tree's admissibility standard. Does not answer O3 either way.

Smooth domain-wall braneworlds with bulk scalars and no junction condition; asymmetric thick branes also exist (1910.09530, 2004.11398, 2407.14693). Confirms by title/abstract that thin-brane + Z2 is one class of braneworld, not the definition.

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested: this result is a construction/definition (RS 1999; SMS 2000; Israel 1966), not an inference from data. RS2 eq 5 is an identity between free parameters and a fine tuning the authors 'accept without further explanation'; SMS eq 15-18 are geometric identities. Nothing measured enters, so no later datum (LHC KK searches, sub-mm gravity bounds on k and M5, H0/Lambda) can move it -- those constrain parameter values within the construction, not what a braneworld is. The Z2 assumption was motivated by theory (Horava-Witten), not by data, and later work (Konya and refs) drops it without contradiction. Evidence: the sympy re-derivation reproduces every published equation with no numerical input. Having more data does not change the conclusion; what changes the tree's use is literature, not data -- asymmetric and thick braneworlds published 2000 onward.
grade_evidence: The source-level content -- a braneworld is a bulk solving its field equations with a brane whose stress tensor comes from a brane action, the Israel condition being the delta part of those equations -- STANDS and is re-derived exactly (C1-C3, RS2 eq 5 and SMS eqs 15, 18 reproduced; the tree's Israel form is correct in the Poisson/Konya sign convention). But the tree's four-item list (latticectc.py:78-81, :141-143) is an RS-type-specific definition used as a general one: Z2 is an imposed extra hypothesis at source (SMS 'we impose'; RS2 drops the orbifold condition, p.5) and is machine-checked unnecessary (C4/C4b); the junction condition is not independent of the field equation (C3); thin branes are not required (C5). The tree's CONCLUSION survives the narrowing: CODIM1_CTC_IS_BRANEWORLD_RESULT = False rests on the refused metric having its stress tensor 'read off its own Einstein tensor', which fails even the loosest source-level definition (SMS eq 13: S from a brane Lagrangian, T specified). And O3_ANSWERED_BY (:148-151) already uses the narrower, correct criterion (field equations + Israel, no Z2). So: nothing WRONG, no discrepancy in the quoted formula; the definition as a general admissibility test holds on a smaller class (RS-type, thin, Z2) than the refusal text claims for 'a braneworld'.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the tree restating the refusal as 'no bulk field equation with a specified brane source (hence no Israel condition)' and marking Z2 and the thin-brane form as RS-type specializations, or a reading showing the tree means only the RS class. To WRONG: none foreseeable -- would need the refused construction to satisfy field equations with a specified source, which the tree's own record (stress read off the Einstein tensor) excludes. Reading DeWolfe-Freedman-Gubser-Karch (hep-th/9909134) and Battye-Carter-Mennim-Uzan (hep-th/0105091) at source would upgrade the thick-brane and asymmetric rows from computed+abstract to READ, not change the grade.
